outcome: A cast card moves to the stack as a spell and stays a spell until it resolves, is countered or otherwise leaves the stack.
A copy of a spell is a spell on the stack even with no associated card.
A copy of a card that a player casts is a spell on the stack.
A spell's owner is its card's owner (or the player who put a copy on the stack) and its controller is the player who put it on the stack.
A copy of a card created and cast by a player is owned by that player.
A noncopy spell has its card's printed characteristics as modified by continuous effects.
A characteristic change applied to a permanent spell by a resolving effect continues to apply to the permanent on the battlefield.
